read.thesis: Q2 adjusted EPS $2.55 vs $1.91 on Calpine addition and better market conditions; nuclear output down to 44,160 GWh and FY guidance raised to $11.50–$12.50, with no supply-side capacity discipline discussed.

utilisation.quote: Excluding Salem and STP, our nuclear plants at ownership achieved a 93.0% capacity factor for the second quarter of 2026, compared with 94.8% for the second quarter of 2025.

triggers.label: FY26 adj. EPS guidance raised to $11.50–$12.50
triggers.quote: Raising full-year Adjusted (non-GAAP) Operating Earnings guidance range to $11.50 – $12.50 per share

triggers.label: Crane restart progressing, targeted 2027
triggers.quote: a major milestone moving us closer to restarting operations in 2027

triggers.label: Nuclear capacity factor 94.8% → 93.0%
